versions.name: Frederick Sprague Barbour Scout Reservation
versions.summary: The Connecticut Rivers Council's designated wilderness camp on 106 forested acres in Norfolk, Connecticut, where units backpack in to pitch tents and cook over open fires with no cabins or drive-in sites, plus trails for hiking, mountain biking, and winter camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Connecticut Rivers Council's Camp Barbour page. The council page gives the street number as 333 Loon Meadow Drive (the source listed 323). Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
